api:
<Ternary data={soils} a={|s: &Soil| s.sand} b={|s: &Soil| s.silt} c={|s: &Soil| s.clay} corners={vec!["Sand".into(), "Silt".into(), "Clay".into()]} />
PropTypeDefault
a, b, cFn(&T) -> f64: the three parts; each row is normalised to 100%required
nameFn(&T) -> &str: the tooltip title"Point n"
groupFn(&T) -> &str: colour and legend entryone colour
cornersVec<SharedString>: names of A (bottom left), B (bottom right) and C (top)A, B, C
divisionsusize: grid lines per side10
point_sizef32: radius in pixels5.
legendLegendshown with a group

examples.title: Soil texture
examples.description: Sand, silt and clay shares of 45 samples; the grid reads in tens of percent.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn soil() {
    let data = use_signal(soils());
    rsx! { <Ternary data={data} a={|m: &Mix| m.parts[0]} b={|m: &Mix| m.parts[1]} c={|m: &Mix| m.parts[2]} name={|m: &Mix| m.label.as_ref()} group={|m: &Mix| m.group} corners={corners(["Sand", "Silt", "Clay"])} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Three-party vote
examples.description: Vote shares by district, grouped by region.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn election() {
    let mut all = cluster("North", [48., 32., 20.], 4., 12, 6);
    all.extend(cluster("South", [30., 52., 18.], 4., 12, 7));
    all.extend(cluster("Coast", [35., 30., 35.], 4., 12, 8));
    let data = use_signal(all);
    rsx! { <Ternary data={data} a={|m: &Mix| m.parts[0]} b={|m: &Mix| m.parts[1]} c={|m: &Mix| m.parts[2]} name={|m: &Mix| m.label.as_ref()} group={|m: &Mix| m.group} corners={corners(["Red", "Blue", "Green"])} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Copper alloys

fn alloys() {

    all.extend(cluster("Brass", [65., 1., 34.], 3., 10, 10));
    all.extend(cluster("Nickel silver", [60., 18., 22.], 3., 10, 11));

}
